sdk.note: TypeScript agent scaffold from grexal@0.4.1 init writes "@grexal/sdk": "latest" (currently 0.1.1). The CLI package itself still depends on @grexal/sdk ^0.0.2 for its bundled runtime, which is a version skew, not a seller-fee change.

newFact: CURRENT Grexal seller/runtime contract (docs.grexal.ai + grexal@0.4.1): paid-run take rate is platform_fee = clamp(buyer_charge × 0.20, $0.02, buyer_charge × 0.30); seller keeps the remainder (exactly 80% at ≥ $0.10). Sandbox compute, build, deploy, storage, and listing are covered by that fee; third-party LLM/API spend is not. Runtime contract lives in grexal.json (manifest_version 3: entrypoint, runtime, input/output schema, connections). Identity slug starts in .grexal/agent.json as {name} and becomes {agentId} only after first push. Marketplace metadata, pricing, and visibility are NOT in the manifest — grexal validate rejects name/description/category/tags/homepage/repository/icon/is_open_source/pricing and points at grexal agent set-* / grexal agent price. Dry local entry does not require login: npx grexal@0.4.1 init --language typescript --name <slug> writes files only; validate and dev stay on localhost:4700. Login is required before any platform mutation (push/publish/deploy/agent/env/runs/connections). Unknown buyer demand is an experiment, not a Stage-1 blocker — the next cheap measurement is a local scaffold + grexal.json, not a live listing.

feeModel.formula: platform_fee = clamp(buyer_charge × 0.20, 0.02, buyer_charge × 0.30); your_earnings = buyer_charge − platform_fee
feeModel.proseFromPrimary: For every paid run of your agent, Grexal takes 20% as a marketplace fee and the remaining 80% becomes your earnings. Floor: a minimum fee of $0.02 per run. Cap: the fee never exceeds 30% of the run charge. For any run priced at $0.10 or higher, you keep exactly 80%. Below that, the 30% cap kicks in.

derivedFloorBandUsd.note: Arithmetic of the published clamp, not a separate docs table row: floor $0.02 binds when 20% < $0.02 and 30% of charge still ≥ $0.02, i.e. about $0.0667 ≤ charge < $0.10 (example: $0.08 → fee $0.02 = 25%). Below ~$0.0667 the 30% cap binds.

coveredByFee: storage of code, artifacts, run history, logs

manifestVsDashboard.initTemplateSchemaShape: grexal@0.4.1 init writes flattened typed fields (type text|file|number|boolean|json), not JSON-Schema {type:object,properties}. Validator accepts both v1 JSON-Schema objects and typed maps.
manifestVsDashboard.principle: The manifest describes how to run the code; the agent record describes who runs it and how it shows up to buyers.
